$description: Closed asset-role vocabulary, defined from real JSX usage sites (grep of /assets/ paths and live endpoints). Conductor (Melty Labs) is a real, live company: generated output must never reproduce its customer logos, real people's photos or likenesses, real testimonials, its trademarks, or its proprietary docs/changelog text.

may-generate-new.meaning: New original assets may be generated for the slot; the source files must not be copied.

may-reuse-open-license.meaning: Source files are openly licensed and may be reused with their notice.

placeholder-only.meaning: Reserve the slot with a neutral placeholder until the rights holder supplies an asset.

must-not-reproduce.meaning: Real trademark, real person, real customer or proprietary content: never reproduce, imitate or fabricate.

must-not-reuse-live-endpoint.meaning: A live third-party endpoint: never emit the original URL/ids.

brand-mark.licensing: Conductor / Melty Labs trademarks (logomark, wordmark, app icon, brand-kit files).
brand-mark.guidance: Never reproduce, redraw or imitate the Conductor marks. Use a neutral placeholder unless the rights holder supplies the mark for its own use.

customer-logo.licensing: Third-party trademarks: Linear, Vercel, Notion, Ramp, Y Combinator, Square, PostHog, Spotify, Life360, Reducto, Instacart.
customer-logo.guidance: Never reproduce real customer logos or invent logos implying endorsement. Placeholder slots only, or logos supplied with written permission.

vendor-mark.licensing: Third-party marks used in UI: Apple logo, OpenAI mark, Anthropic/Claude mark, X logo, X-style verified badge (origin of the badge file not established).
vendor-mark.guidance: Do not reproduce third-party marks; use neutral icons.

person-avatar.licensing: Real people's photos (testimonial authors, team members) and composer portraits used as demo avatars (file licensing not established).
person-avatar.guidance: Never reproduce a real person's photo or likeness and never generate a photorealistic face attributed to a real name. Use abstract placeholders.

team-photo.guidance: Never reproduce or synthesize a team photo. Placeholder only.

product-screenshot.licensing: Proprietary Conductor UI captures (hero app shot, mobile dock, Slack search, docs and changelog images).
product-screenshot.guidance: Do not copy Conductor screenshots; a deployer supplies their own product captures.

demo-video.licensing: Proprietary product videos (cmdn.mp4; docs/changelog media ~1.1 GiB, incl. 735 MiB and 164 MiB files).
demo-video.guidance: Reserve the slot with a poster placeholder; never embed the original files. Delivery concern: never bundle large videos into a generated page.

decorative-background.licensing: Hero sky illustration and the CTA orchestra photograph (source licensing not established).
decorative-background.guidance: A generator may create NEW original artwork in the same spirit (soft sky / full-bleed photo with dark overlay). Never copy the existing files.

ui-animation.guidance: Create new equivalent micro-animations; do not copy the files.

icon.guidance: lucide icons may be reused with the ISC notice; any other icon must be generated new.

form-endpoint.licensing: Live third-party HubSpot portal (enterprise + team-plan forms) and a live Google Form (Windows/Linux waitlist).
form-endpoint.guidance: Never emit the original portal id, form ids, script URL or Google Form URL. Use local-only-no-submit or a deployer-configured endpoint.

download-endpoint.licensing: Live third-party vendor CDN serving Conductor builds (crabnebula).
download-endpoint.guidance: Never emit the CDN download URLs. Use opens-download-dialog or a deployer-configured endpoint.

pinNote: The authoritative pins live in code (COMPLIANCE_PINS in schema/semantic_validate.py and extraction/verify_all.py), not in this file, so editing this file alone cannot relax them. Membership in the policy enum is not enough: these roles must equal their pinned value.

contentRules.testimonials: Never fabricate a testimonial or attribute a quote to a real person without consent.
contentRules.people: Never fabricate team members or reuse real bios.
contentRules.docsAndChangelog: Never copy Conductor's docs or changelog text; never invent releases.
contentRules.legal: Legal text comes from counsel only.
